text: Chhote bhai ne\nbas ek baat kahi...\naur sab badal gaya!
Clue isi video\nmein hai.\nDhyaan se dekhna!
Vikas ke gale ka\noperation hua tha...
Hafte bhar se wo\nkaagaz par likh kar\nbaat karta tha
Aaj subah Vikas\nstudy mein kursi par\nMARA MILA!
PATNI ANJALI\n"Main 10 baje hi\nso gayi thi"
DRIVER BHOLA\n"Poori raat garage\nmein gaadi saaf ki"
CHHOTA BHAI ROHIT\n"Raat 11 baje bhaiya\nne mujhse kaha..."
Shivam ki nazar se\nkoi nahi bachta.
